body.title: Updating BAMOE Canvas

ul.li: Save your existing projects to the browser.
Install your new version of BAMOE Canvas by replacing your existing installation or by using the blue-green deployment strategies (blue/green deployment strategies).

body.p: If you want to know how to install BAMOE Canvas, see Installing

ul.li: If you have installed a parallel version, use Canvas Import functionality to import your saved projects. See Importing existing projects

body.p: To know more on projects, see Step 4a.
